_readme: This is YOUR personal config — fork this repo and make it yours.
It extends base.json (team tools) and layers your own extras on top.
HOW TO POPULATE THIS FILE:
Option A — Snapshot this machine  (recommended)
Run setup-cli.ps1 → 'Snapshot this machine'
It scans what's installed, lets you pick what to keep,
encrypts the result to snapshot.enc, and adds tools here.
On a new machine: clone this repo → 'Restore snapshot' → done.
Option B — Add tools manually
Copy the example entry below and fill in the fields.
winget search <name>  →  use the Id column as 'winget'
choco search <name>   →  use the package name as 'choco'
FIELDS:
name         required  display name, must be unique
description  optional  shown in the picker
checkCommand required  PowerShell expression — truthy = already installed
choco        optional  chocolatey package name
winget       optional  winget package ID
fallbackUrl  optional  shown if both package managers fail
To override a base.json entry (e.g. pin a version), add an entry
with the same 'name' here — yours wins.

tools._comment: ── Add your tools here, or use 'Snapshot this machine' to auto-populate ──
